newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt police nab museum thief inspired by movie.
newsitem.headline: Egypt police nab museum thief inspired by movie.

text.p: Egyptian police arrested a man who tried to steal antiquities from the Egyptian Museum including a dagger from Tutankhamun's tomb, the museum's director said on Thursday.
Director-General Mohamed Salah said the thief, inspired by an Egyptian comedy film called "How to Steal a Million Pounds", entered the museum on Tuesday and hid beneath a showcase until closing time.

During the night, he broke open several display cases and snatched the priceless antiquities, including several gold bracelets and a gem-encrusted dagger which had belonged to the boy-king Tutankhamun.
"He thought he could escape by disappearing among the visitors in the morning, but we banned all Egyptians from the museum. When he came out of hiding we caught him," Salah said.
